trials.claim: Access to 300,000+ premium royalty-free music tracks and sound effects with unlimited licensing
trials.claimQuote: Get 300,000+ premium, royalty-free music tracks and sound effects with unlimited licensing
trials.reasoning: The vendor states unlimited use applies only 'with an active subscription,' materially limiting the claimed unlimited licensing.

exhibits.quote: there are no limits to the number of times you may use our music, the number of productions that you create, the number of copies of the production that you make, or where in the world you distribute with an active subscription.
exhibits.argument: Unlimited use is conditioned on maintaining an active subscription, not lifetime unlimited licensing.

exhibits.quote: They would NOT lift a finger nor help in ANY WAY because YouTube treated their music as piracy aka unlicensed and belonging to other companies!!
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the royalty-free music triggered piracy claims and vendor provided no help.

exhibits.quote: AudioHero has over 300,000 premium royalty free music tracks and sound effects.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms the 300,000+ premium royalty-free tracks and sound effects count.

exhibits.quote: Use any sound as many times as you like, without any additional fees or contracts.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms unlimited royalty-free use without additional fees.

trials.claim: Offers over 300,000 premium royalty-free tracks and sound effects with unlimited licensing
trials.claimQuote: AudioHero offers over 300,000 premium, royalty-free music tracks and sound effects with unlimited licensing.
trials.reasoning: The vendor limits the purchase to 'synchronization rights only' and conditions unlimited use on an active subscription, contradicting unlimited licensing.

exhibits.quote: Your purchase of the Sounds includes synchronization rights only.
exhibits.argument: License is limited to synchronization rights only, not unlimited all-rights licensing.

exhibits.quote: there are no limits to the number of times you may use our music, the number of productions that you create, the number of copies of the production that you make, or where in the world you distribute with an active subscription.
exhibits.argument: Unlimited use is conditioned on maintaining an active subscription, not lifetime unlimited licensing.

exhibits.quote: AudioHero has over 300,000 premium royalty free music tracks and sound effects.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states it offers over 300,000 premium royalty-free tracks and sound effects.

exhibits.quote: Over 300,000 tracks and SFX, ranging from cinematic trailers and upbeat corporate pop to subtle background ambiences and hyper-specific sound effects
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the library has over 300,000 tracks and SFX.

trials.claimQuote: Access new sounds every week to keep your selection fresh
trials.reasoning: A buyer found no evidence of weekly additions and reported the visible SFX count fell from about 306k to 304k.

exhibits.quote: the promise of new sound FX added every week is not supported by the facts that I can tell.
exhibits.argument: Buyer audit found no evidence supporting weekly new sounds.

exhibits.quote: And the total number of visible SFX actually went down to ~304k from ~306k.
exhibits.argument: Library count decreased over a week instead of growing with new additions.

trials.claim: Can filter tracks by genre, length, mood, or tempo
trials.claimQuote: Filter tracks by genre, length, mood, or tempo to find the right sound
trials.reasoning: A buyer directly confirms filtering by mood, genre, tempo, instruments, and duration.

exhibits.quote: The search and filtering system is fast and actually helpful—filter by mood, genre, tempo, instruments, or even duration.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms filtering by mood, genre, tempo and duration works.

exhibits.quote: The search and filtering system is a dream.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the search and filtering system works well.

trials.claim: Generate custom sound effects with AI by typing what you need
trials.claimQuote: Generate custom sound effects with AI just by typing what you need
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms an AI sound FX generator exists; complaints about its quality do not show the generation feature is absent.

exhibits.quote: the AI sound fx generator is bad. To be fair, even the premiere AI sound FX generator (ElevenLabs) is bad.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the AI sound effects generator performs poorly.

exhibits.quote: But this is bad enough to be gimmicky if not entirely impractical
exhibits.argument: Buyer describes the AI generator as gimmicky and impractical for real use.

exhibits.quote: Search is quite adequate, even prompting a phrase "need music for..." is possible.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms you can type a phrase to prompt and find music.

exhibits.quote: the AI sound fx generator is bad. To be fair, even the premiere AI sound FX generator
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms an AI sound FX generator exists, even while criticizing quality.
